label: D2: rare a2->S1 transition when the a2 choice was weakly supported (after an unrewarded trial or a switch)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and essentially only on rare transitions where the agent chose a2 and landed in S1 (input state S1 with last action a2); a2->S1 alone covers 99.9% of activation mass but has precision 0.16, and it never fires on D1/GO, a1 choices, common transitions or S2. Within a2->S1 rare steps it is gated by how weakly the a2 choice was supported: it is strongly enriched when the previous trial was unrewarded (89% of mass) or when a2 was a switch (stay==0, 5x lift), and when S1 is the hidden good state (chose_good==0). It is mostly silent on a2->S1 rare steps during entrenched rewarded a2 streaks with S2 good. Top activations are switches to a2 after unrewarded trials while S1 is good, i.e. landing in the state the agent was moving away from. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables (stay is known at D2). Adding good==1 instead of the stay clause gives dev F1 0.58 vs 0.51; next_stay==0 (agent switches back next trial) has precision 0.83 but recall 0.41. Dev: P 0.36, R 0.87, F1 0.51, mass recall 0.96.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 7 (9 = most a1) (+5.96), phase=D2 & this=a2 S1 (+5.02), in_action=2 (+2.96), in_state=1 (+1.89), phase=D2 & before=a1 S1 u (+1.74), phase=D2 & before=a2 S2 u (+1.42). Lower it: ep_bucket=0 (-6.40), common=1 (-4.79), choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (-4.72), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (-4.71).
